name: Netflix
instructions: Go to Account > Membership & Billing > Cancel Membership. You will retain access until the end of the current billing cycle.

name: Spotify Premium
instructions: Log in to your Spotify Account page > Under 'Your plan' click 'Change plan' > Scroll down to 'Cancel Spotify' and confirm.

name: Disney+ Hotstar
instructions: Open Hotstar app or web > My Space / Help & Settings > Subscriptions > Cancel Subscription.

name: Amazon Prime
instructions: Open Amazon app > Your Account > Manage Prime Membership > End Membership and Benefits.

name: YouTube Premium
instructions: Open YouTube app > Profile photo > Purchases and memberships > Select membership > Deactivate.

name: Swiggy One
instructions: Open Swiggy app > Account > Swiggy One Membership > Manage / Do Not Auto-Renew.

name: Zomato Gold
instructions: Open Zomato app > Profile > Zomato Gold > Manage Membership > Turn off Auto-Renew or Cancel.

name: Cult.fit (Curefit)
instructions: Open Cult.fit app > Profile > Active Packs & Subscriptions > Select Membership > Cancel / Pause Subscription.

name: Zerodha Coin (SIP)
instructions: Open Coin app > Mutual Funds > SIPs > Select the Fund SIP > Click Delete / Pause SIP. Also cancel the e-Mandate in Console.

name: Groww (SIP Autopay)
instructions: Open Groww app > Mutual Funds > SIPs tab > Select Active SIP > Tap Options (3 dots) > Cancel SIP.

name: Airtel Autopay
instructions: Open Airtel Thanks app > Pay / Bills > Manage Autopay > Disable Autopay on your Postpaid / Fiber connection.

name: Jio Fiber / Autopay
instructions: Open MyJio app > Menu > JioPay > Autopay Mandates > Select active mandate > Revoke / Cancel.

name: Google One Storage
instructions: Open Google Play Store > Profile Icon > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Google One > Cancel subscription.

name: Apple Services / iCloud
instructions: On iPhone: Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions > Select subscription > Cancel Subscription.

name: Claude
instructions: If you subscribed through Google Play: open Google Play Store > Profile icon > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Claude > Cancel subscription. If you subscribed on claude.ai or the iOS app, manage it from Settings > Billing there instead.

name: Google Play
instructions: Open Google Play Store > Profile icon > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions, pick the app and tap Cancel subscription. This is the only place a Play Store subscription can be cancelled; the Autopay entry in your UPI app only shows 'GOOGLE'.
